refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: y = _czt(x) y = _czt(x, m) y = _czt(x, m, w) y = _czt(x, m, w, a)

listitem.para: Total number of steps. Default is the length of the input signal.
Ratio between points in each step. Default is exp(-2*%i*%pi/m).
Starting point in the complex plane. Default is 1.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `czt` function computes the Chirp z-transform of the input signal `x`. It calculates the frequency response starting at `a` and stepping by `w` for `m` steps. The parameter `a` is a point in the complex plane, and `w` is the ratio between points in each step. The radius increases exponentially, and the angle increases linearly.
